# 06_Sound (wildcard style)

The style's sound pack: 48 kHz, 24-bit WAV, every file peaking at -1 dB. `stingers/` holds the soundtrack of every video in the kit.

## Folders

| Folder | What is in it |
|---|---|
| [`chimes/`](chimes/) | The ASTRIS chime on its own, the two-note motif, and the motif with its chord. |
| [`clicks/`](clicks/) | Clicks, ticks and a tap: for text, buttons and small moments. |
| [`impacts/`](impacts/) | Impacts: soft, medium and big. |
| [`risers/`](risers/) | Risers, for building into a moment. |
| [`stingers/`](stingers/) | The soundtrack of every video in the kit, on its own (the same sound that is baked into each MP4). |
| [`tactile/`](tactile/) | The sounds that make this style feel like itself. |
| [`whooshes/`](whooshes/) | Whooshes, short to long. |
